uncertainObservations: The number of goblets in the sky arc cannot be stated reliably. Counting them one by one I resolve roughly 10 to 12 evenly spaced vessels, with the arc appearing symmetrical about the center; the outermost ones at both left and right sit close to the frame edge and to the border, and the pale rendering makes it impossible to confirm the exact total. Recording null rather than a number.

The number of foreground goblets on the cloth cannot be fixed either: at least five separate vessels are individually visible in the lower center-left, but several overlap each other and the pale cloth, and more may be hidden behind the nearest ones.
Whether small pale shapes drifting in the mid-sky (near the center-right, below the arc) are falling petals, leaves or birds is not determinable.
The faces of all four figures are turned away; no expressions, features or genders are visible.
Whether the flower shapes in the second figure's hair form a continuous wreath or are scattered blossoms is ambiguous.
The distant structure reads as a building with pointed roofs but its details dissolve into haze.
